comment: What each plan includes, as one list every plan card reads. A feature row says how to tell from an offer row whether that offer includes it, so a check or an X is always what the service actually grants: `access` (the offer's access_refs name it), `access` with `without_allowance` (it names it and puts no allowance on it; a free plan with an allowance keeps nothing, src/person-store.mjs), `allowance_of` (the offer's allowance on that access, or unlimited when it grants it with none), `usage_of` (the offer's own usage row for that meter in src/usage-meters.json: how much comes with the plan and what more costs, words from src/usage-meters.mjs; an offer with no such row is judged by the row's `access` instead), or `every_account` (every account has it whatever it pays: connecting an AI). A row's `paths` are the requests that ARE that feature: the person's store (src/person-store.mjs) and the Worker (src/worker.mjs) refuse them to anyone whose plan the row does not include, judged by the same rule the card shows (`withheldFeature`, src/plan-comparison.mjs), so a card and what the service grants cannot disagree. A path is `{ "exact": <path> }` or `{ "under": <prefix> }`, with an optional `method` when only that verb on the path is the feature: the spaces row withholds only starting a Space, so a person on any plan opens and works in a Space someone invited them into. `compares` picks which offers are plans: the ones granting that access. Other offers show their own benefits. A row judged by `allowance_of` names its `unit` (the thing counted, plural) and the `per` an unlimited plan is read over, so every value is the same short number-unit/period a person scans across plans: "5 decisions/month", "Unlimited decisions/month" (an allowance keeps its own period). A row with `paths` names in `needs_plan` what a person on a plan without it is told when a screen of it opens: a short title naming what a paid plan unlocks (src/workspace/failure.ts). A row with `shown` false is gated exactly as written but is no line on any plan card (src/plan-comparison.mjs planFeatures, and every card built from it, skips it): a card claims only what is true today, and its wording never changes who can use what. `words.needs_plan` is said when a refusal names no feature row, and `words.needs_plan_action` is the one button, to Plan.

plan_names.comment: The names a plan can take, lowest rung first. A rung that names an `offer` is a plan sold today and takes its name from that offer row's `label` (records/commercial-offer-records.json), the one place a sold plan's name is written; a rung with only a `name` is ready for a plan that does not exist yet. A new plan between two rungs takes the rung's name as its offer label and the rung's `name` becomes that `offer`. Every name here is kept out of anything shared publicly (src/private-rewrite.mjs).
plan_names._not_carried: Rungs with only a `name` (plans that do not exist yet) are not carried into this public folder: their names are kept out of anything shared publicly. They stay with the private product source.
